scope: Normalized national retail menu entries for design research; not a verified comprehensive Glenview sellable menu. Portion, preparation and package variants are grouped; ingredients and catering products are not top-level items.

cashier_feedback.notes: Three cards; 3/4/10 slots; half/full control in Default; Mix & Match collapses; category tile selector.

side_scope_feedback.notes: For now, Default and You Pick Two side choices are Apple, Chips and Baguette only.

bagel_tuesday_feedback.notes: Collapsed Bagel Tuesday card above Mix & Match; flavor and numeric quantity per row; running total with a 13-bagel target. Totals over 13 are visibly flagged and remain editable/saveable.

programs.label: Default
programs.note: Drink-only notes are allowed. An empty card is unused; missing side/size are review prompts, not capture blocks.

programs.label: You Pick Two
programs.note: Two food slots; eligible portions come from the offer record, not from a universal half rule.

programs.label: Bagel Tuesday
programs.note: One bundle per car in this design. The 13-bagel target is advisory; preserve every positive integer quantity and visibly flag totals over 13. Flavor rows can be added beyond 13.

programs.label: Mix & Match
programs.note: The cashier sketch specifies 2–10. Capture limit 10 is a user layout requirement; historical published maximum 11 is retained as evidence.
